_comment: The tone carrier. The enemy squad is six guys who booked the field for the afternoon and did not expect this. They are cocky at six, rattled at four, openly blaming each other at three, and quietly falling apart at one. Nobody is hurt. Nobody is in danger. They are just losing, in front of their friends, and it is going badly.
_rules: No profanity, no slurs, no threats of real harm. Roblox Mild, and it is funnier clean anyway.
Never reference injury, blood, weapons, or death. They are OUT. They walk off. They are fine and they are annoyed.
Specificity beats volume. 'Marcus' is funnier than 'someone'.
The squad has names so the blaming lands. Names are assigned at match start from the roster below.
Lines are drawn without replacement inside a match so nobody repeats until the bank is exhausted.
